<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="ניסן_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518917795_theRebbe_561" batchId="meluket-_D7_A0_D7_99_D7_A1_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518917795_theRebbe_561__p007">
  <section v="18">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The answer "We were slaves to Pharaoh in Egypt and Hashem took us out with a strong hand" applies even to one at the level of a newborn or a slave, showing a leap from the lowest to the highest revelation.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">A)</t>
    <t s="2">And the answer: "We were slaves to Pharaoh in Egypt, and Hashem took us out of Egypt with a strong hand" —</t>
    <t s="3">that even one who is at the level of an infant at the moment of birth</t>
    <t s="4">(including one who is at this level simply,</t>
    <t s="5">and not like the wise son, for whom being at this level is due to his ascents),</t>
    <t s="6">and moreover,</t>
    <t s="7">even one who is in the state of a slave to Pharaoh in Egypt</t>
    <t s="8">(before the birth of the Exodus from Egypt),</t>
    <t s="9">Hashem takes him out of Egypt with a strong hand,</t>
    <t s="10">for "with a strong</t>
    <t s="11">hand" is the intensity of the revelation, to the extent that there was revealed</t>
    <t s="12">upon them the King of kings, the Holy One, blessed be He, in His glory and in His very Self, and He redeemed them,</t>
    <t s="13">which is a leap</t>
    <t s="14">from one extreme to the other,</t>
    <t s="15">from the very lowest</t>
    <t s="16">(slaves to Pharaoh in Egypt)</t>
    <t s="17">to the very highest — the revelation of "in His glory and in His very Self."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="19">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>So too will the future redemption be for us, a leap from the extreme darkness of exile to the revelation of Hashem's glory and kingship with the coming of Moshiach.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And so it will be for us,</t>
    <t s="1">"As in the days of your going out from the land of Egypt, I will show him wonders,"</t>
    <t s="2">a redemption by way of a leap from one extreme to the other,</t>
    <t s="3">that from the double and multiplied darkness of exile,</t>
    <t s="4">and especially in the generation of the heels of Moshiach, where the darkness is even greater,</t>
    <t s="5">they come immediately to the revelation of "And the glory of Hashem shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see,"</t>
    <t s="6">and "Kingship shall be Hashem's,"</t>
    <t s="7">with the coming of Moshiach our righteousness,</t>
    <t s="8">speedily in our days, literally.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
